name: Aluminium
line: Cool product-page precision: a machined aluminium search instrument, a two-column specification comparing smokers and lifelong non-smokers on one 0–150 per 1,000 scale, and each explorer presented as a product that rises and settles onto a lit plinth while its three figures count up.
notes: The signal red appears once, as the dot after the wordmark. Network drawings are shown in greyscale with a CSS filter; game screenshots are desaturated until hover. Secondary text uses #5F656C (a slightly darker steel) to pass AA on aluminium. Red Hat Display and Red Hat Text on Google Fonts are Latin-only, so Chinese and Russian pages would fall back to system fonts.
